messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a 404 in the runtime runbook when following the 'networking' anchor. Link lands on a 404: https://redwood.dev/docs/private/runtime#networking -> looks like the anchor should be #networking-vpc. Anyone owning the runtime guide?

jamie: oof, good catch. want me to claim and open a quick PR?

alex: yes please. small sed should fix anchors if the section name didn't move. I think the file is runtime/private-deploy.md in the docs repo.

taylor: I'm the runtime guide owner but OOO today. jamie — go ahead and claim. also noticed the vpc diagram (img/private-vpc.png) returns 403 on staging, so please rehost to kb-cdn if you can.

jamie: grabbing it now. plan: 1) update the anchor in the markdown, 2) rehost the image to kb-cdn and update the path, 3) add a small redirect rule if needed, 4) run a quick smoke test. will open WIP PR shortly.

jamie: PR WIP -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423 

Here's the sed I used locally to change the anchor:

```bash
sed -i "s/#networking\b/#networking-vpc/g" runtime/private-deploy.md
```

(just replacing the in-page link target, not moving content)

docs-bot: Deploy preview created for PR #8423 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/8423 (checks running)

taylor: looks good from my side. add a one-line changelog and assign yourself. @sre-oncall can you confirm CDN policy for that asset? we usually require kb-cdn + cache-control.

sre-oncall: confirmed. kb-cdn is preferred, size under 200KB ideally, set Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800. if original PNG is private or blocked, rehosting is required.

alex: thanks everyone. small follow-up — if redirects are easier than editing a bunch of incoming links, we can add a single netlify redirect for the old anchor path. happy to put that in a separate tiny PR if jamie's busy. :thumbsup:

jamie: I'll add a redirects line to this PR so it's atomic. hoping to get tests green and merge today. ping me for quick review.
